evidence: Touches `src/httpserver.cpp` and `src/httpserver.h` to encapsulate HTTP request state handling under the RPC/REST/ZMQ area.
rationale: Internal refactoring encapsulates HTTP request state transitions and removes `HTTPRequest::SetState()` to prevent callers from arbitrarily overwriting the state enum. While this enforces state invariants at compile time rather than by convention, it is an internal design cleanup without an exploitable bug or external user-facing impact.
